title: From Rashomon Theory to PRAXIS: Efficient Decision Tree Rashomon Sets
abstract: arXiv:2606.00202v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Standard machine learning pipelines often admit many near-optimal models. These "Rashomon sets" pose a range of challenges and opportunities for uncertainty-aware, robust decision making. They allow users to incorporate domain knowledge and preferences that would otherwise be difficult to specify directly in an objective, and they quantify diversity among valid models for a given training dataset and objective function. However, computation of Rashomon sets, even for simple, interpretable model classes such as sparse decision trees, continues to require immense memory and runtime resources. We present PRAXIS, an algorithm to approximate this Rashomon set with orders of magnitude improvement in runtime and memory usage. We validate that PRAXIS regularly recovers almost all of the full Rashomon set. PRAXIS allows researchers and practitioners to scalably model the Rashomon set for real-world datasets. Code for PRAXIS is available

translated_title: 从罗生门理论到PRAXIS：高效的决策树罗生门集
translated_abstract: 标准机器学习流程通常会产生许多接近最优的模型。这些“罗生门集”为不确定性感知的稳健决策带来了诸多挑战与机遇。它们允许用户融入领域知识和偏好——这些内容往往难以直接在目标函数中指定——并且能够量化针对给定训练数据集和目标函数的有效模型之间的多样性。然而，即使对于简单、可解释的模型类别（如稀疏决策树），罗生门集的计算仍然需要巨大的内存和运行时间资源。我们提出了PRAXIS，这是一种近似计算罗生门集的算法，在运行时间和内存使用方面实现了数量级的改进。我们验证了PRAXIS通常能够恢复几乎完整的罗生门集。PRAXIS使研究人员和从业者能够可扩展地对真实世界数据集的罗生门集进行建模。PRAXIS的代码已公开。
tldr: PRAXIS算法在运行时间和内存使用上实现了数量级的改进，能够高效近似计算稀疏决策树的罗生门集（近优模型集合），并且通常可以恢复几乎完整的罗生门集，从而使真实世界数据集的罗生门集建模变得可扩展。
en_tdlr: PRAXIS is an algorithm that approximates Rashomon sets of sparse decision trees with orders-of-magnitude improvements in runtime and memory usage, regularly recovering almost the entire full Rashomon set and enabling scalable Rashomon set modeling for real-world datasets.
